output.summary: The reported 98% on-time figure is measured against revised promised dates, and revisions rose from about 2.8 to 14.1 per 100 shipments after the dispatcher bonus took effect at each center (Northgate and Riverside in March 2026, Pell Junction in July). Customer-requested and weather revisions did not rise; capacity-coded revisions did. Against original commitments, the largest customer's on-time rate fell from 87% to 81%. RouteWise go-live does not match the timing of the increase, and the portal does not explain lateness complaints that rose before its launch. Driver shortage is correlated with revisions but not established as the main driver. The campaign and the 99% bonus tier should not proceed. Recompute on-time against original dates first, then re-base the incentive. The $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
